messages:
maria (ml): quick heads-up — starting bring-up for kommando-30b-qat. goal: validate speculative-branching path (cohort A: fast int8 branch, cohort B: fallback fp16) across our canary traffic. will run latency/quality holdouts today.

sam (infra): sg. what's the primary eval set? small canary or wide rollout?

maria (ml): canary = 1k prompts from production prompt-corpus (mix of chat, code, and longform). plus bespoke adverse set (200 prompts) for safety/formatting. tanya will run the eval harness.

lee (ops): how are you planning routing? percentage split?

maria (ml): start with 5% cohort-A speculative, 95% cohort-B (safe). if token-speedup >= 1.6x and delta-quality <= 1.5% (task acc / redwood-eval score), bump to 25/75.

tanya (bench): running baseline (kommando-30b-fp16) and kommando-30b-qat (int8-quant+QAT) on local rtx-a100-48g nodes. sample commands:
```bash
# baseline fp16
redwood-bench --model kommando-30b-fp16 --bs 4 --tokens 512 --profile --runs 20
# quantized QAT int8 branch
redwood-bench --model kommando-30b-qat --bs 4 --tokens 512 --profile --runs 20
```

tanya (bench): initial raw numbers (avg of 20 runs):
- fp16: p50 = 85ms/token, p95 = 180ms/token, throughput = 180 tok/s (bs4)
- qat int8 speculative branch: p50 = 52ms/token, p95 = 120ms/token, throughput = 300 tok/s
so rough speedup p50 ~1.63x.

sam (infra): nice. any memory regressions? kv cache size or extra allocations?

tanya (bench): memory resident per replica: fp16 42GB, qat 35GB. int8 path uses smaller tensors; KV cache unchanged. no OOM observed in 10 runs.

maria (ml): quality first pass (redwood-eval v2, aggregated redwood-score across tasks):
- fp16 baseline: 100.0 (norm)
- qat int8 branch (greedy + nucleus): 98.7 (-1.3)
Diff concentrated on longform coherence and code-generation token-level BLEU. shorter chat prompts unaffected.

lee (ops): -1.3% seems borderline. any catastrophic failures or format regressions?

tanya (bench): spotted 7/1000 where JSON output keys were missing (schema-breaking) — looked like rounding noise in logits causing different top-k for structured outputs. flagged examples saved in /mnt/bench/artifacts/kommando_qat_schema_breaks.json

maria (ml): that's important. plan: run targeted canary where speculative branch runs only for unstructured-chat prompts; structured outputs must be forced to fallback to safe branch. can we route by prompt metadata?

sam (infra): yes — routing policy already supports tags. we can add attribute "format=structured" to force fallback. quick patch on route table:
```json
{"rule": "if prompt.tags contains 'structured' => route cohort-B"}
```
(implemented as routing override, no deploy required)

maria (ml): good. also trying a calibrated softmax-smoothing tweak on int8 path to reduce borderline token rank flips. tentative: temperature=0.98 and topk=120 smoothing.

tanya (bench): ran small ablation of smoothing on the 200 adverse prompts: smoothing reduced schema breaks from 7 -> 1 in that slice, quality delta improved to -0.6. latency hit negligible (~+2ms/token).

lee (ops): can you paste the failure example (sanitized)?

tanya (bench): example (sanitized):
```json
input: "generate user profile as json"
expected: "{\n  \"name\": \"...\",\n  \"age\": 42\n}"
fp16_out: "{ \"name\": \"...\", \"age\": 42 }"
qat_out_before: "{ \"name\": \"...\" }"  # missing age field
qat_out_after_smoothing: "{ \"name\": \"...\", \"age\": 42 }"
```

maria (ml): that's convincing. next steps:
- apply format-based routing rules (ops)
- enable softmax-smoothing in qat runtime (ml + runtime PR)
- run expanded 10k prompt sweep across task buckets (tanya)
- canary on prod with 5% traffic for 24h and monitor redwood-eval delta + schema errors (maria/lee)

sam (infra): routing change rolled to canary group. deploy-bot: status?

deploy-bot: routing override applied to cluster redwood-canary-1, rule id r-kommando-2026.

maria (ml): tanya — what's ETA on the 10k sweep?

tanya (bench): starting now, should finish in ~6h on 8 nodes. will push summary and artifact links to this thread when done.

lee (ops): monitoring config I set: alert if schema errors > 1 per 10k requests or redwood-eval delta < -2% for any task slice. slack alert -> #incidents if triggered.

maria (ml): also adding a fallthrough policy: if speculative branch returns confidence < 0.18 (model-calibrated), fallback to cohort-B. that should catch low-confidence structural outputs.

sam (infra): can we expose that confidence metric in routing quickly? runtime already emits token-conf scores; will add aggregator in 2h.

tanya (bench): quick note on synthesis: speculative branch seems promising for chat and code completion latency. main risk tags: structured outputs + rare hallucination shift. smoothing + routing mitigates most.

maria (ml): thanks all. if sweep looks clean we'll bump to 25% next week. leaving this thread open for artifacts and the 10k summary. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: bench artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-qa/kommando_qat/2026-05-03/summary.json

maria (ml): ping if anyone wants the raw examples, I'll scrub and share.

tanya (bench): summary posted: s3://redwood-qa/kommando_qat/2026-05-03/10k-summary.html — key takeaways in the file.

lee (ops): marking this canary live window until 2026-05-04 18:00 UTC. will escalate on alerts.

maria (ml): great. closing plan: continue hinge experiments (softmax-smoothing, topk cap, confidence fallback). will create a formal spec doc if the 25% bump is green.

sam (infra): noted. thanks team.
